headline: SparseTech slips out of ARC-3 gold places to 20th

sections.text: SparseTech dropped from 19th to 20th on ARC-3, with its score unchanged at 37.98, which is now 0.22 short of the gold line.
The gold line rose 0.22 in the past day to 38.20, the score at 19th, the last of the 19 gold places, so the rise pushed SparseTech just outside.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
